# ReShape Complete Specification & Developer Guide

## Overview
ReShape enables AI agents to model, sculpt, and review 3D assets in Blender using iterative passes and matched-view comparisons.

## When to use this
Use ReShape when:
- Creating 3D models in Blender from images, briefs, or meshes.
- Executing iterative sculpting passes (Blockout -> Volumes -> Surface).
- Capturing matching front, profile, and three-quarter renders to audit silhouette fidelity.
- Running mesh validation for game engines, 3D printing, or animation rigging.
- Connecting autonomous agents to Blender via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Architecture & API
ReShape provides a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://reshape.eduardoaugusto.work/mcp`.
Supported JSON-RPC 2.0 methods:
- `initialize`: Establishes protocol handshake and declares capabilities.
- `tools/list`: Enumerates `reshape_model`, `reshape_compare_views`, `reshape_validate_mesh`, `reshape_list_skills`, `reshape_inspect_anatomy`.
- `tools/call`: Executes specified tool with input arguments.
- `resources/list`: Lists anatomy references and styling guides.
- `prompts/list`: Pre-configured prompts for 3D asset generation and review.

## Installation in Codex
```bash
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills
tar -xzf reshape-skill.tar.gz -C ~/.agents/skills
```
